newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks close up in slow pre-Easter session.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks close up in slow pre-Easter session.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed up a hair in a typically slow session ahead of the Easter holidays, traders said.
"Next week should be much the same ... few investors, fewer brokers and a sluggish market," said one broker.
Many Venezuelans traditionally take advantage of markets being closed next Thursday and Friday to take a whole week's holiday. "It's like this every year," said another broker.
The 19-share .IBC index closed up 0.86 percent at 6,278.98 points as 16 million shares traded worth 1.9 billion bolivars ($4 million), according to preliminary bolsa figures.
The Merinvest composite .MRCP index, which includes telephone company CANTV, closed up 0.57 percent at 96.73.
Among traded stocks, 21 rose, 12 fell and four closed flat.
